title: The Helpful Pup
lines: Our pup Bud is small and harmless.
But Bud is helpful when a sock gets lost.
Meg lost a sock and felt sad.
She looked in the box. It was useless.
Bud went to smell the rug.
He dug up the sock for her.
Meg was thankful for her helpful pup.

questions.listenFor: A sock. Simple to find - have them put a finger on the line that says it.

questions.ask: How did Bud find the sock?
questions.listenFor: He went to smell the rug, then dug it up. Listen for both halves of that.

questions.ask: When has someone been helpful to you? Tell me about it.
questions.listenFor: Any story is fine. You are listening for them to use the word helpful themselves.
